heroTitle: Gawing Pangmatagalang Kita ang Iyong Traffic
heroSubtitle: I-promote ang buong iGaming brand — slots, live casino at sports betting — na may transparent na tracking, flexible na commission models at buwanang USD payouts.
commissionTitle: Mga Commission Model na Para sa Scale
commissionSubtitle: Piliin ang deal structure na tumutugma sa kalidad ng traffic at monetization strategy mo. Ang custom rates ay dine-negotiate base sa volume, GEO at acquisition channel.
revshareDesc: Kumita ng patuloy na porsyento ng Net Gaming Revenue (NGR) mula sa referred players. Ang RevShare ay kinakalkula sa cash gameplay GGR minus bonus cost — aligned sa tunay na player value.
revsharePoint1: Lifetime revenue share sa qualified player activity
revsharePoint2: Transparent na breakdown ng GGR, bonus cost at NGR sa portal mo
revsharePoint3: Ideal para sa SEO, content at community-driven traffic
cpaDesc: Tumanggap ng fixed one-time payment kapag nakumpleto ng referred player ang qualifying first deposit. Perpekto kung kailangan mo ng predictable upfront returns.
cpaPoint1: Single payout sa first qualifying deposit
cpaPoint2: Malinaw na qualification rules na napagkasunduan nang maaga
cpaPoint3: Pinakamahusay para sa paid media at high-volume acquisition funnels
hybridDesc: Pagsamahin ang upfront CPA at ongoing RevShare sa parehong player. Balansehin ang immediate cash flow at long-tail earnings mula sa active players.
hybridPoint1: CPA sa first deposit plus RevShare sa future activity
hybridPoint2: Flexible split na naaayon sa traffic profile mo
hybridPoint3: Popular sa influencers at mixed-channel partners
benefitsSubtitle: Namumuhunan kami sa conversion, retention at product depth para patuloy maglaro ang referrals mo — at patuloy kang kumita.
benefit1Desc: I-promote ang slots, live dealer tables, crash games at sports betting mula sa isang brand — mas maraming paraan para i-convert ang bawat bisita.
benefit2Desc: I-track ang referred players, deposits, turnover, GGR, bonus cost, NGR at commission accruals mula sa dedicated dashboard.
benefit3Desc: Maaaring gumawa at mag-manage ng sub-affiliates ang top-level partners na may controlled commission models at performance visibility.
benefit4Desc: Ang closed-month commissions ay available para sa payout sa USD via bank transfer, crypto o e-wallet — subject sa minimum thresholds.
benefit5Desc: Ang KYC, AML at responsible gaming standards ay pinoprotektahan ang brand at tumutulong mapanatili ang long-term player trust at retention.
benefit6Desc: Makipagtrabaho nang direkta sa partnerships team namin para sa deal terms, creatives, landing pages at campaign optimization support.
howSubtitle: Mula application hanggang payout sa apat na simpleng hakbang.
step1Desc: Mag-email sa partners@ibets24.com kasama ang traffic sources, target markets at promotional methods mo. Sinusuri namin ang fit at compliance bago onboarding.
step2Desc: Ang approved partners ay nakakakuha ng unique referral code, tracking link at access sa Affiliate Portal na may live performance reporting.
step3Desc: Magpadala ng traffic sa pamamagitan ng link o code mo. Dapat mag-register ang players at matugunan ang eligibility requirements sa ilalim ng Terms at KYC policies namin.
step4Title: I-track, I-optimize at Makatanggap ng Bayad
step4Desc: I-monitor ang player stats araw-araw, i-refine ang campaigns at humiling ng buwanang payouts kapag naabot ng closed-month commissions ang minimum threshold.
portalTitle: Lahat ng Kailangan Mo sa Isang Portal
portalSubtitle: Ang existing affiliates ay nag-sign in para i-manage ang referrals, stats at payouts.
portalFeature1: Referral link at code na handang kopyahin at ibahagi
portalFeature2: Player-level statistics na may custom date ranges
portalFeature3: Commission history at available payout balance
portalFeature4: Payout details at withdrawal requests sa USD
businessDesc: Bukod sa affiliates, nakikipag-collaborate kami sa licensed game providers, payment solution partners, marketing agencies at technology vendors na nagbabahagi ng aming standards para sa fairness, security at responsible gaming.
ctaTitle: Handa na Bang Lumago Nang Sama-sama?
ctaSubtitle: Sabihin sa amin ang tungkol sa audience at traffic channels mo. Tutugon ang team namin na may tailored commission terms at next steps.
supportNote: Para sa player account, payment o bonus issues, makipag-ugnayan sa support@ibets24.com — hindi sa partners inbox.
